fees.info: A one off fee required to document and settle your loan.

fees.name: PROPERTY_VALUATION_FEE
fees.info: This fee covers the cost of valuing your property. When valuation is required, cost may vary dependant on a number of factors. Cost will be confirmed prior to o

fees.name: HOME_LOAN_SECURITY_VARIATION
fees.info: When there is a variation made to the security used for an existing loan agreement. Charged per security.

fees.name: LOAN_VARIATION
fees.info: When there is a variation made to the terms of an existing loan agreement. For example principal reduction, change to loan term.

fees.name: LOAN_TOP-UP
fees.info: Additional establishment fee for increasing your VARIABLE rate home loan at any point after the home loan has been finalised. Does not include Fixed rate loans

fees.name: RECONTRACTING_FEE
fees.info: Any amendments made to the loan after the loan contract has been created but before it has been funded will incur a fee.

fees.name: DIRECT_DEBIT_DISHONOUR
fees.info: Charged if your direct debit payment is dishonoured due to insufficient funds

fees.name: UNUSED_LIMIT
fees.info: Calculated on the daily available balance and posted to the account monthly

eligibility.info: Must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident, with an Australian residential address
Be able to meet SCCU assessment criteria and demonstrate capaity to repay the loan
Provide acceptable residential mortgage security which must be insured with SCCU noted as interested party
